match.userMessage: One greyscale storyboard frame. Frozen in this action: Scarlett snaps the lipstick shut, puts it in the tote, and doubles back for her phone. Framing: medium wide, eye level, Scarlett stays centered against cream hallway walls, her coral lips and lipstick hand as the focal points while the tote and radiator shelf create depth behind her. Placement only, not the pose: Scarlett strides toward camera through the hallway, carrying the lipstick in one hand and a canvas tote in the other, phone still on the radiator shelf behind her. Camera, as one or two arrows: truck, smooth. Characters: Scarlett, Female, 20s, A sharp-eyed young woman of medium height, A sleek black turtleneck with a streamlined black-and-neutral. The bodies are frozen in that action: if someone sits, they are seated; if someone reaches, the arm is extended. One figure per character. Drawn as a storyboard artist's animatic frame: confident pencil line with flat grey marker tones, three or four values, greyscale only even where the description names a colour. Clear silhouettes, the set blocked in with simple shapes. Camera travel is one or two arrows. A rough pre-production drawing: not a finished illustration, not a photo, not a 3D render. The drawing fills the whole image edge to edge: no border, no frame line, no paper margin, no grid of panels. No text, no titles, no subtitles, no watermarks, no letters, no words, no signs, no UI elements.
